{{Quote|We understand that the surrender deadline has now passed, with no undertaking from the Gibadan government. The Emperor has now authorized the use of force to restore order.|A news reporter|<ref name="IC:501st" />}}
The '''Devastation of Gibad''' occurred in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]. When the government of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gibad/Legends|Gibad]] refused to cooperate after the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] given deadline, [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] ordered that the [[FG36]] virus&mdash;created by [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Ovolot Qail Uthan]], a native of the planet&mdash;be unleashed upon its populace. As all [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] watched the destruction of the [[Human/Legends|Human]] population of the planet, the Empire released a statement proclaiming that the world would be ready for re-population within a [[Standard year/Legends|year]].
